verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability documented is that users can 'import or sync your contacts and activity data', which processes many records at once. Cursor-paginated reads of up to 200 events per page support bulk retrieval. No bulk create, update or delete API endpoints or batch jobs are evidenced, and nothing shows the MCP server or AI agents acting on many items in one operation. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch write API endpoints, bulk operations via MCP/agents, bulk update/delete across items, hands-on corroboration.
